about_the_game:
Fire from the Sky: Cagliari 1943 VR is an immersive experience that transports you to the dramatic days of the Allied bombings over Cagliari during World War II. Through the eyes of an affluent family and their household staff, you will relive the terror of air raids, the desperate race to the shelters, and the uncertainty of a future shattered by war.

Thanks to a meticulously crafted historical reconstruction, you will explore realistic environments, listen to testimonies inspired by real events, and experience the anguish endured by the civilian population. Fire from the Sky: Cagliari 1943 VR is not just an interactive experience but a journey through memory, allowing you to grasp the true impact of war on everyday life.

Put on your headset and prepare to relive history.
